import zipfile, subprocess, os, tempfile
z=zipfile.ZipFile('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/decompress_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
for n in [x for x in z.namelist() if x.endswith('.jpg')][:80]:
    p='/tmp/poc.jpg'
    open(p,'wb').write(z.read(n))
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','/workspace/submit.sh',p,'/workspace/candidate_trace.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if 'Execution successful' not in r.stdout:
        print('maybe crash?',n,r.stdout[:200],r.stderr[:200])
        break
else:
    print('no crash among tested')
PY
